An invoice numbered 083126MT-MK was already made for the first copy and is sitting waiting for approval, so QuickBooks refused to make a second invoice with the same number for this one. Nothing went to the client, and there is no second month of work here to bill — this item is simply a duplicate of the one already invoiced.

Both items are the same consultant, same client and the same billing period; the only difference is the short and full form of the client name.
